sources.notes: Official organiser KMZ contains full vector SS LineStrings for all 10 distinct stage roads (all 20 SS) plus explicit 'SS x/y - Start' and 'SS x/y - Finish' Point placemarks, so kind would be 'route' on data grounds; set to 'points' ONLY because the site Terms of Use forbid communicating/reproducing content to the public without written permission (same treatment as Greece). routeRef kept for reference if permission is obtained. Start/finish taken from the explicit Start/Finish placemarks (within 25 m of the line ends; max 25 m at SS10/15 finish, 13 m at SS3/7 finish, others <=2 m). Line length vs official: SS1/5 Vodice - Brest: line 14.25 km vs official 14.12 km (+0.9%); SS2/6 Lake Butoniga - Motovun: line 13.84 km vs official 13.78 km (+0.4%); SS3/7 Beram - Cerovlje: line 23.96 km vs official 23.78 km (+0.8%) [LineString drawn finish->start]; SS4/8 Učka: line 11.76 km vs official 11.75 km (+0.1%); SS9/16 Platak: line 16.08 km vs official 16.26 km (-1.1%) [LineString drawn finish->start]; SS10/15 Ravna Gora - Skrad: line 10.44 km vs official 10.13 km (+3.1%); SS11/14 Generalski Stol - Zdihovo: line 22.57 km vs official 22.48 km (+0.4%); SS12/13 Pećurkovo Brdo - Mrežnički Novaki: line 9.14 km vs official 9.11 km (+0.4%); SS17/19 Bribir - Novi Vinodolski: line 14.28 km vs official 14.17 km (+0.8%); SS18/20 Alan - Senj: line 14.62 km vs official 14.56 km (+0.4%). Shakedown LineString 'Shakedown' (folder Thursday 9 April/Signs) = 3.55 km vs official 3.44. Quirk: liaison 'SS 9 Finish - TC 10' begins at the SS 9/16 TC point rather than at the finish; the SS 9/16 Start/Finish placemarks are unambiguous, so not considered a problem. Name matching is exact (KMZ names carry the SS numbers); no uncertain matches.
